findings.description: The key omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material protecting the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived static key material increases the volume of data under a single key and the blast radius of a key compromise.

No explicit policy is attached, so AWS applies the default key policy delegating full access to the account root principal, meaning any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions can use or administer the key. For a key protecting log data this removes any separation of duties around decrypting or tampering with audit logs.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, shortening the window in which an accidental or malicious schedule-key-deletion can be cancelled. Destruction of this key would render the encrypted logs bucket contents permanently unrecoverable, aiding an attacker seeking to destroy audit evidence.
